newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Nokia heads higher.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Nokia heads higher.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications equipment company Nokia Group rose Monday to highlight quiet trade in American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) Friday.
"We've got nothing major here today," a trader said, attributing the featureless trade to calm after Friday s so-called triple witching expirations of futures and option.
Nokia was up one to 72-3/4 after trading as high as 73-3/8, well above the 12-month closing high of 72-7/8. One trader said recent data showed Nokia was "poised for a breakout."
The company reported Monday it had joined an accord with U.S. and Japanese computer firms to form a set of standards for building mobile telephone network computers.
Fellow Nordic telecom equipment company Telefon AB L.M. Ericsson rose 1/2 to 37-3/4.

Singapore's Asia Pulp & Paper Ltd rose 3/4 to 14-1/2 on volume of 2.4 million ADRs, more than 30 times normal trade. The activity was dominated by a block trade of more than 1.8 million shares, but details about the trade were not immediately available.
Britain's National Westminster Bank Plc rose four to 77-7/8 following press reports of a bid from or merger with rival Barclays Plc. Barclays was up 3/4 to 78-1/4.
Decliners led advancers 239 to 229 among 814 ADRs. The ADR group rose 0.08 percent and volume in late morning was 29 million shares.
